title: LotKeys Info
summary: The V0.9.4.75 team-test build repairs shared popup surfaces, clarifies tiny leaderboard scores, and cleans the public extension package.

blocks.text: Inventory, Listing, wrap-up and other popups now reliably restore their solid rounded theme surface after a viewed public Profile is closed with Android Back or Escape. Tiny colored leaderboard scores gain a compact dark shadow for readability. The public package keeps only the current Posting Buddy V0.1.16 download and its update pointer; duplicate source and older release ZIPs are excluded.
